source.description:
PROBLEM: Live runs die in ~2s with 0 turns: appendEvent fails after 5 attempts with UNIQUE constraint failed on specialist_forensic_events.job_id + seq. Observed duplicate seq rows (seq 2,2 for one job) -- two writers assign the same seq, the loser retries into the same collision. Every retry of the job re-hits the poisoned seq. Evidence: 8+ failed live researcher runs on unitAI-9tawb, 2026-09-08/09. This blocks the joint Exa researcher landing live test.

SUCCESS: Concurrent forensic writers never emit duplicate (job_id, seq); a retry of a poisoned job either resumes cleanly or fails with a causal error, never an infinite UNIQUE loop; live researcher run passes turn 0.

SCOPE: Specialists repo forensic write path (src/activation/forensic-sink.ts and its seq assignment + callers). Debugger-first: prove single vs dual writer and where the second seq comes from before changing code.

NON_GOALS: Exa/researcher changes; core #636; kernel double-load (sibling bead).

CONSTRAINTS: observability.db remains authoritative forensics; no event loss tolerated -- dedup must not drop events. Suite green, tsc clean.

VALIDATION: Regression test with concurrent writers asserting unique seqs; live researcher turn-0 pass recorded on unitAI-9tawb.

OUTPUT: Fix commit plus findings in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: medium
source.notes: Joint sequencing 2026-09-09: core holds live-test rerun until dd52z lands; #300 update-from-base agreed (no pair-merge); core native-HTTP Pi-entry fix held in scratch until my word; #636 green untouched.
source.title: Forensic dual-write seq race poisons job retry (UNIQUE job_id+seq)
